method: Thunk 0x18df760 and pair worker 0x18ddd30 run natively with the dynamic, static and flagged pair handlers, recycled-link acquire, tree searches, both pointer-vector reserves, the native lock xadd claim cursor and the native global serial increment. Contact/filter/neighbor/pool/scratch services and the allocator are supplied; Python composes run_pose_pair_worker with the reconstructed handlers and acquire.
comparisons: ordered supplied-service calls with every argument
0x90-byte link snapshot at contact generation and destruction
all fixture bytes: provider, worker owner, pairs, both trees, bodies, kind records, existing/recycled/refilled links, vectors and new allocations
coverage: dynamic, static (incl. 0x8002/4 skip), flagged-found/new and zero-c0 skip classes
found and new links, filter accept/reject for both
mutation trials: services bump the shared cursor or change the provider count between claims
failure_proof: Reading link+0x84 flags before the destructor call in acquire fails at worker case 0.
Pushing a found link after filter rejection fails at worker case 2.
limits: Single native worker with scripted cursor interference; no concurrent threads or atomic guarantee for the Python claim adapter.
Contact generation, filter, neighbor, refill, destructor, scratch and allocator behavior are authored stand-ins.
Trees are authored unbalanced BSTs (search only); fixture links are synthetic.
Merge 0x18df4e0/0x18df630 and rebalance 0x1989e60 are not reconstructed here.
